rows.grounds: accusative adjective or apposition to taṃ

items.question: What arises when one knows that hidden true nature?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature produces all-knowingness.
items.inference: Therefore knowing the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ may modify taṃ or stand in apposition; exact referent depends on context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
